metadata.snapshot_rule: persist raw response and sha256 before or at each origin; metadata_observed_at must be <= origin

ohlcv.integrity: exactly one row per required hourly open_time; no missing or duplicate rows

normalization: uppercase exact Binance symbol; UTC timestamps; decimal close values; no aliases
failure_behavior: metadata outage, stale snapshot, ambiguous contract identity, ambiguous source, or unavailable required bar blocks; no alternate exchange, spot, coin-margined, synthetic, arbitrary-third-party, or silent fallback
revision_rule: retain original observed bytes and any later revision evidence; never silently overwrite a sealed receipt
